_README: Cook, Sabato's Crystal Ball and Inside Elections all answer 403 Forbidden to
this collector, so ratings arrive this way or not at all. A rating change is
among the more newsworthy things that happens in a race, which is why the
manual route exists rather than the field simply staying empty.
1. Read the rating off the handicapper's own page.
2. Add or edit an entry below. Set as_of to the date THEY published it,
not today, and set url to the page you read it from so anyone can check.
3. When a rating moves, put the old label in `previous` — that is what the
app compares to decide a change is worth notifying about.
4. Commit. The git history is the audit trail for who changed what, when.
The app labels every entry here as hand-entered. Do not remove that label to
make the screen tidier: a typed figure and a scraped one carry different
guarantees and must not look alike.
Entries go stale silently, so the collector warns once an entry passes
MANUAL_RATING_STALE_DAYS. Re-check the page and bump as_of, or delete it.
lean is R, D, or null. Use null for Toss-up.
Shipped empty on purpose. Nothing here was invented to fill the screen.
